# Access operation capabilities

Native read, in-memory modeling and persistence have separate qualification boundaries.

| Operation | Supported | Qualified boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model.create` | Yes | New Jet4/ACE12-targeted in-memory model with separately assessed native creation. |
| `model.edit` | Yes | Typed tables, columns, primary-key definitions, relationships, inert query text and rows; rollback and read leases. |
| `model.rows.read` | Yes | Forward-only DbDataReader over modeled or qualified native tables; modeled input retains omitted/null distinctions. |
| `native.header.inspect` | Yes | Inert bounded header/profile, page-alignment, byte/page limits and snapshot SHA-256. Independent Jet3/Jet4/ACE12/ACE14/ACE16/ACE17 fixtures. Protection and feature values are not decoded. |
| `native.catalog.read` | Yes | Unprotected Jet3/Jet4 and ACE12/14/16/17 catalogs, selected table/column schemas, index definitions, relationships and inert links. Jet4/ACE properties are qualified; Jet3 property maps retain opaque bytes. System/unknown catalog entries remain separate. |
| `native.rows.read` | Yes | Bounded forward-only native scans, deleted/overflow/fragmented rows, lazy fields and incremental binary streams. Qualified Jet3 single-byte scalar/Memo/OLE and Jet4/ACE Unicode, complex-value, attachment, BigInt and extended-date profiles; calculated/unknown values retain bytes and diagnostics. |
| `native.query.records.read` | Yes | Exact inert Jet3/Jet4/ACE query records and typed parameter inventory. Simple single-table SELECT and two-part UNION SQL reconstruction is qualified; other query SQL remains explicitly unavailable. |
| `native.create` | Yes | Seed-free unprotected Jet4/ACE12 output from new table models; qualified scalar/Unicode/long values, sequential AutoNumber seeds, primary/unique/composite indexes and enforced single-field relationships. General legacy ASCII collation subset; unsupported types, keys, queries and lossy values fail before output. |
| `native.preserve` | Yes | Immutable native snapshot copied without byte changes to the same family/profile, including opaque/protected/compiled content. Source identity is checked; signature validity and protected-content decoding are not assessed. |
| `native.edit` | No | General native row/schema editing is unqualified. VBA source and ordinary-module persistence use the separate vba.edit contract. |
| `native.convert` | No | Known complex-field, rich-text, BigInt, extended-date and unqualified opaque-property target mappings are diagnosed. Native conversion and persistence remain unavailable. |
| `application.objects.read` | Yes | Jet3 catalog identities and exact catalog payloads with preserve-only definitions; Jet4/ACE application inventory and exact payloads; qualified ACE version-21 designer sections/controls/sources/event metadata, 76-byte StopMacro definitions, table data-macro XML and resource metadata. Jet version-19 designers and unknown definitions are preserve-only. Dependency references are partial and inert. |
| `application.objects.write` | No | Form/report object creation, general designer changes and macro authoring are unqualified. Code-behind uses vba.edit; selected inert event edits use application.events.write. |
| `application.events.write` | Yes | ACE expanded version-21 form/report Open, label/text-box/combo-box Click and text-box/combo-box AfterUpdate binding/clearing without execution. Replacing Click removes its associated embedded macro. Jet version-19, nonempty deltas and other control/event layouts reject edits. |
| `vba.inspect` | Yes | Access Jet4 compound storage and ACE hierarchy adapt to shared Core MS-OVBA parsing. Jet3 VBA storage remains unqualified. Module source and stored references are decoded when available; compiled/unknown streams remain exact. Built-in references and signature validation are outside this contract. |
| `vba.edit` | Yes | Detached shared Core project editing and explicit native Jet4/ACE12/14 persistence. Qualified unsigned/unprotected storage supports ordinary module source/add/remove/rename and new/existing code-behind on existing forms/reports; retained host bindings, catalog identities and unrelated pages remain preserved. First projects require an existing qualified native application. Unknown storage/permission/index/signature layouts reject mutation. |
| `protection.inspect` | No | Password, encryption and signature state is NotAssessed. |
| `report.render` | No | Native report definitions and expression evaluation are not qualified. |
